acceptanceCriteria: Define the supported relocated executable/runtime closure for application attestation commands, or explicitly document the Homebrew Node launcher exclusion.
Retain actual original-versus-staged launcher reproduction and fail-closed unavailable behavior with focused validation.
Any implementation remedy preserves legacy wire/pins and requires independent review plus consuming-path qualification.
body: Confirmed compatibility limit during V1-0556 PTF live work on base f51f3c9e6fbfc5a6b219692e8bf46e4e43297a36, installed Core1.0.0-rc.1 build163/Tasks build202/Node22.23.3 Darwin arm64. prepareApplicationAttestationProvider copies only the executable to scratch. Actual /opt/homebrew/Cellar/node@22/22.23.3/bin/node stages but exits -6: dyld cannot find @rpath/libnode.127.dylib beside the staged launcher. Reproduction: copy that executable into an owned private scratch directory, invoke --version. Original launcher works; staged copy fails. Evidence /private/tmp/corvint-394-node-stage-repro/result.json, source internal/jstestprovider/application_attestation.go. Expected a qualified command must run within its admitted runtime closure, or document/refuse this unsupported relocated launcher explicitly. Actual command is unavailable and fails closed; no false positive. PTF fixture uses a native Go attestor instead; no widening of legacy support requested. Dedup agent-memory attestation and staging searches found no matching item. Preserve launcher/runtime boundary; do not fix by copying arbitrary host libraries without a separately accepted qualification.
title: Application attestation staging cannot execute the Homebrew Node launcher
